style: Say brightly and clearly, in a friendly, encouraging way, like an upbeat coach at the gym.
lines: Welcome to the Comeback Club! I'm Bix. Pick a room and let's practice something hard.
Welcome back! Let's keep practicing.
Let's set a goal. Pick one card, then pick what you'll try when you get stuck.
This is my locker. Everything here, I earned by practicing with you.
Pattern Ladder. Find what comes next.
Memory Mirror. Watch the pads, then copy them.
Light Mat. Tap a square to flip it and its neighbors. Light them all.
Number Lift. Use the buttons to reach the target floor.
Summit Circuit. One hard puzzle from every room. Let's go.
Not yet. What could we try?
Hmm. That one's tricky. Pick a strategy.
Not yet is okay. Let's look again.
Got it!
Nice thinking!
We came back! That's a comeback stripe.
You didn't give up. Look at my headband!
All that practice is paying off!
Goal done! A new room just opened.
Goal done! You did just what you set out to do.
We made it to the summit. Thanks for practicing with me.
Practice makes things easier.
Mistakes show us what to practice next.
Want to try a new room?
This room opens when you finish a goal.
Try a new way.
Slow down and check.
Here's a hint.
Let's take three slow breaths. In... and out.
Let's break it into parts.
Ask a friend what they notice.
Breathe in.
Breathe out.
Ready to try again?
Tap an open door to start a room. Tap Bix to see a move.
This room opens when you finish a goal. Go to Goals to pick one.
Pick one goal. Tap a card on the board.
Make a plan. Pick the strategy you will try first when you get stuck.
Your goal is set. Go to the Gym and practice.
Every goal is done. You can still practice in any room.
This is Bix's locker. Tap a Coach's corner card to flip it. Press Save Bix to keep your progress on this computer.
Solved! Press Next rung when you're ready.
A comeback! Press Next rung when you're ready.
Solved again! Replays are free practice.
Fewest moves! Press Next rung when you're ready.
Room complete! Go back to the gym and pick a room.
Watch the pads.
Your turn. Tap the pads in the same order.
That pad was not next. Press Watch again to see it again.
Out of moves. The mat went back to the start.
Out of moves. The lift went back to floor zero.
This floor can't get back to the target. The lift went back to floor zero.
Turn to a neighbor. Ask: what do you notice?
Goal done! What helped most? Tap a card, or Skip.
Pick a new goal in Goals when you're ready.
Try the glowing square.
Try the glowing button next.
Look at the jumps between neighbors, not just the items.
Watch each one light up, one at a time.
Look at the labels under the pattern.
Say the names as they light up: star, moon, leaf...
Here it comes again, slower.
Watch it in small parts.
Pressing a square twice undoes it. Each square needs at most one press.
Now each press shows the squares it flipped.
Fix the top row first. Then look at what is left.
Try working backward from the target floor.
Now each move shows its math.
Aim for the floor with the flag first.
Look at the brackets. Each one shows the part that repeats.
Say it out loud: circle, square, circle, square...
How much bigger is each number than the one before?
Find the part that repeats. How long is it?
Count the jump from 3 to 6. Does it stay the same?
Write the jumps: 1, 2, 3, 4... What is the next jump?
Count how many dots get added each time.
Is it adding the same amount, or something else?
Turn your hand the way the arrow turns.
Add the two numbers just before the blank.
Double the number, then take away 1.
Next is the star.
Next is the moon.
Next is the leaf.
Next is the heart.
Practice helps. When you keep practicing something hard, it usually gets easier over time.
Not yet. A mistake shows you what to practice next. "Not yet" means you are still learning.
New strategies. Trying a different way often works better than trying harder the same way.
Ask for help. Asking someone for an idea is a strategy that strong learners use.
Slow breaths. A few slow breaths can help you feel calmer when you are stuck or upset.
Clear goals. A good goal is specific, so you can tell when you have reached it.
